name: Speech — Russian, higher voice
description: The same Russian voice shifted three semitones up, duration preserved (resample + tempo compensation).

models.purpose: Piper voice model, ONNX Runtime CPU

parameters.label: Text to speak
parameters.default: Привет! Это локальный синтез речи. Всё считается на твоём ноутбуке, без интернета.

notes: Pitch is applied after synthesis: the WAV is resampled to move the spectrum, then atempo restores the original duration, so only the voice moves and the timing does not.
